name: Cummins Arabia
legal_name: Cummins Arabia (Cummins Saudi Arabia Limited, Cummins Arabia FZCO, Cummins Kuwait); 50:50 JV of Cummins Inc. and The Olayan Group
employees: Over 550 professionals (Cummins press release, April 2025); close to 500 employees of 30 plus nationalities at launch (June 2017)
revenue: Cummins Arabia revenue not published. Parent Cummins Inc. FY2025 revenue USD 33.7 billion, net income USD 2.8 billion; Power Systems segment sales USD 7.463 billion (investor.cummins.com, 2026-02-05)
sector: Distribution, sales and service of Cummins diesel and gas generator sets (2.5 kW to 3500 kW), engines, filtration, parts, BESS and HHP rebuild in Saudi Arabia, UAE and Kuwait
positioning_text: Cummins Arabia is the exclusive Cummins distribution and service JV for Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Kuwait, formed in 2017 by Cummins Inc. and Olayan, whose Cummins distribution history in Saudi Arabia dates to 1956. It runs 10 service branches, 8 warehouses, an HHP Master Rebuild Center and a service training centre with 550 plus staff. Its competitive position in Gulf power generation rests on the Cummins HHP range (QSK60, QSK78, QSK95 and the new Centum Series) for 60 Hz Saudi and 50 Hz UAE and Kuwait data centres, the PowerCommand controls and DMC paralleling family, and the 2025 addition of factory BESS. The 73.2 MW Saudi hyperscale delivery and the first EMEIA BESS commissioning in Dubai are its current reference points.

movements.headline: Cummins Arabia completes DMC6000 master controller retrofit for a Riyadh telecom operator
movements.summary: Three 800 kW QSK23-G3 gensets at a major network and communication service provider in Riyadh moved from a 20 year old MC-150 master controller to a PowerCommand DMC6000 with PCC3300 upgrades, completed in a six week shutdown window under Cummins Arabia supervision.

relevance.analysis: Installed-base modernisation is a repeatable revenue line in KSA telecom and data centre sites running legacy PowerCommand controls. Cummins Arabia can package DMC6000 retrofits with service contracts as a defensive move against competitor replacement offers.

movements.headline: Cummins launches containerised BESS in the UAE through Cummins Arabia
movements.summary: Cummins Power Generation, Cummins Arabia and Cummins Middle East launched the LFP battery energy storage range in Dubai, with Amit Deshpande (Managing Director) and Emad Lotfy (Power Generation Business Director) quoted. Cummins Arabia was described as 550 plus staff, 10 service branches, 8 warehouses, an HHP Master Rebuild Center and a training centre across UAE, KSA and Kuwait.

relevance.analysis: Gives Cummins Arabia a hybrid genset plus storage offer for rental, data centre and oil and gas customers before most genset competitors in the Gulf have a factory-branded BESS with genset controller integration. The 50 Hz only listing means KSA 60 Hz sites need confirmation of a 60 Hz variant.

movements.headline: Cummins Arabia publishes 73.2 MW Saudi hyperscale data centre reference
movements.summary: Thirty DQLC and six DQCA enclosed gensets (36 units, 73.2 MW) were delivered in seven months to a regional technology provider's hyperscale sites across Saudi Arabia, engineered for 50 C ambient with remote radiators, dual ACB panels, Ni-Cad batteries and fuel coolers, tested to Uptime Institute requirements.

relevance.analysis: This is the proof point for 60 Hz QSK78 supply into KSA hyperscale programmes. The case study states the customer recommended Cummins Arabia for future phases, so follow-on capacity should be protected with reserved production slots given Cummins Inc reports record data centre order books.

movements.headline: Cummins announces S17 Centum 17 litre genset up to 1000 kW
movements.summary: New S17 engine based Centum Series (C600D6E to C1000D6ED, 60 Hz, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency) with 25,000 plus hours of validation and a three year base warranty, aimed at commercial, healthcare and water treatment standby.

relevance.analysis: A 1 MW class set on a 17 L block cuts footprint and fuel against 23 L to 30 L competitors in the 600 to 1000 kW band that dominates KSA hospital, commercial and telecom tenders. Cummins Arabia should confirm 60 Hz availability for Africa Middle East and price it against Cat C18 and mtu 12V1600 class units.

movements.headline: Cummins reports FY2025 revenue of USD 33.7 billion; Power Systems sales USD 7.46 billion
movements.summary: Full year 2025 revenue USD 33.7 billion (down 1 percent), net income USD 2.8 billion, EBITDA USD 5.4 billion. Power Systems segment sales USD 7.463 billion with EBITDA USD 1.694 billion (22.7 percent); Q4 Power Systems sales up 11 percent on data centre demand in North America, China and Asia Pacific.

relevance.analysis: Power Systems is the growth engine of the parent, but the cited demand regions do not include the Middle East. Cummins Arabia competes internally for HHP allocation; documented Gulf pipeline visibility is what secures slots against North American and Asian data centre orders.

movements.headline: First Cummins BESS in EMEIA commissioned at Cummins Arabia Al Quoz, Dubai
movements.summary: A C400B5ZE (422 kWh / 200 kW) was commissioned in Q3 2025 at Cummins Arabia's Al Quoz facility for peak shaving alongside containerised diesel gensets; Q4 2025 results were 12.7 MWh discharged, 382 generator hours and 5,443.5 litres of diesel avoided.

relevance.analysis: A live, metered hybrid reference on Cummins Arabia's own site is the demonstration asset for rental fleets, remote oil and gas camps and construction sites in the UAE and KSA. The measured fuel and runtime savings give the sales team quantified payback material.

movements.headline: Cummins raises 2030 targets and announces large-engine capacity and product investments at Analyst Day
movements.summary: At its 2026 Analyst Day Cummins raised 2030 financial targets and announced further capacity and product investments to strengthen positioning in mining and power generation; Power Systems President Jenny Bush said demand for reliable power is accelerating at an unprecedented pace. Dollar and GW figures are in the presentation, not the release.

relevance.analysis: Added HHP capacity is the constraint that decides whether Cummins Arabia can bid multi-hundred megawatt KSA data centre phases on schedule. Cummins Arabia should lock forward allocation agreements for QSK78 and QSK95 sets while capacity ramps.

movements.headline: Cummins to supply HSK78G and QSK60 gas gensets for Circe Energy HPC data centres in West Texas
movements.summary: Behind-the-meter prime power natural gas microgrids for AI and HPC data centres using HSK78G (C2000N6CD) and QSK60 (C1400N6) gensets, deliveries 2026 to 2030 with modular deployment from 2027.

relevance.analysis: Gas prime power for data centres is now a Cummins reference model. In KSA and the UAE, where pipeline gas is available at industrial sites, Cummins Arabia can propose HSK78G prime power or bridging power for data centre and industrial loads waiting on grid connections.

movements.headline: Cummins introduces QSK78 Centum Series to the 50 Hz market
movements.summary: New 50 Hz HHP Centum gensets on the QSK78 platform, up to 3500 kVA standby and 3300 kVA continuous for data centres, with PowerCommand 3400, Centum Transmission Drive, Tier 2 and Low NOx options and HVO compatibility, announced from Daventry, UK for Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific and Latin America.

relevance.analysis: Extends the data-centre-optimised Centum footprint to the 50 Hz UAE and Kuwait markets where the C2750D5 and C3000D5 previously carried the QSK78 range. Cummins Arabia should obtain the model data sheets and position the 3300 kVA continuous rating against Cat 3516E and mtu 20V4000 offers in UAE hyperscale tenders.

movements.headline: Cummins Q2 2026: Power Systems sales up 19 percent to USD 2.3 billion, outlook raised
movements.summary: Q2 2026 revenue USD 9.5 billion (up 9 percent), net income USD 932 million, EBITDA 17.5 percent. Power Systems sales USD 2.3 billion (up 19 percent) with EBITDA USD 552 million (24.5 percent) on robust data centre standby orders; full year revenue growth guidance raised to 10 to 13 percent.

relevance.analysis: Strong global order intake tightens HHP lead times and pricing power for the parent. For Cummins Arabia the implication is lead time discipline in Gulf bids and early engagement with consultants so that Saudi and UAE projects are in the order book before slots fill.

movements.headline: Cummins wins 5 MWh BESS supply for a large US data centre
movements.summary: Cummins selected to supply LFP battery energy storage systems with 5 MWh nominal capacity for a large US data centre project, its largest BESS deployment to date, to manage AI-driven load fluctuations and support utility interconnection requirements.

relevance.analysis: Validates BESS as a data centre product line, not only a remote-power line. Cummins Arabia can bundle BESS with genset blocks in KSA and UAE data centre proposals to address load-following and interconnection ramp requirements.

movements.headline: HSK78G certified for hydraulic fracturing (EPA Tier 2 mobile off-highway)
movements.summary: The 78 litre, 12 cylinder HSK78G natural gas engine, rated 3000 bhp, received EPA Tier 2 large spark-ignition mobile off-highway certification for well servicing, joining the Spark-Ignited Pumping Power portfolio.

relevance.analysis: Relevant to Cummins Arabia's oil and gas engine business as Saudi unconventional gas programmes expand; also confirms the HSK78G platform's power density that underpins the C2000N gas genset range offered in the Gulf.

partnerships.scope: 50:50 three-country distribution joint venture. Olayan has distributed Cummins products in Saudi Arabia since 1956; the JV consolidated Cummins' wholly owned UAE distributor, General Contracting Company (KSA) and General Transportation and Equipment (Kuwait). Announced 2016-03-29, launched May 2017.

why_it_matters.analysis: Olayan's Saudi standing and 70 years of Cummins distribution history give Cummins Arabia access and localisation credentials that imported-brand dealers cannot match in KSA government and Aramco-linked procurement.

partnerships.partner: Cummins Inc. (Cummins Power Generation, Cummins Middle East)
partnerships.scope: Cummins Inc. is the 50 percent JV partner and sole OEM supplier; Cummins Middle East co-hosted the 2025 UAE BESS launch and the New Energy Solutions EMEIA team supported the Dubai BESS commissioning.

why_it_matters.analysis: Direct factory alignment (Power Systems, New Energy Solutions) gives Cummins Arabia first access to new products such as Centum and BESS, but also means Gulf allocation depends on Cummins Inc's global prioritisation.

partnerships.scope: MoU to develop powertrain solutions and technical support for defence applications in the Middle East (fleet analysis, feasibility studies, post-installation services), signed in Dubai after IDEX 2023; Ian Norton, Operations Director, Cummins Arabia, quoted.

why_it_matters.analysis: Defence powertrain support is adjacent to the genset business but opens military end-user relationships in the UAE that can carry tactical and base power generation opportunities.

partnerships.partner: Regional technology provider (hyperscale data centre operator, unnamed)
partnerships.scope: 36 gensets (30 DQLC, 6 DQCA) totalling 73.2 MW across multiple hyperscale sites in Saudi Arabia, delivered in seven months with FAT per model and Uptime Institute compliant balance of plant.

why_it_matters.analysis: The customer recommended Cummins Arabia for future projects per the case study; this account is the anchor for repeat 60 Hz QSK78 volume in KSA and a reference for other operators.

partnerships.partner: Major network and communication service provider (unnamed telecom), Riyadh
partnerships.scope: Controls modernisation of three 800 kW QSK23-G3 gensets (MC-150 to DMC6000, PCC3200 to PCC3300) with long-term spare parts support.

why_it_matters.analysis: Demonstrates lifecycle service revenue from a 20 year old installed base; template for Saudi telecom and utility retrofit programmes.

partnerships.scope: Authorised Cummins distributor in Bahrain (outside Cummins Arabia territory); supplied 13 Cummins gensets (C55D5I to C275D5I) to BAPCO petrol stations in 2025.

why_it_matters.analysis: Context only: Bahrain is served by a separate Cummins distributor, so Cummins Arabia's territory stops at KSA, UAE and Kuwait.
